prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1169; do not mention it.)
text: This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the rear-end collision described in your file. Please direct all further communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, email, or mail. We ask that you provide the full liability policy limits applicable to the at-fault driver, along with a certified copy of the declarations page, within fourteen days of receiving this letter. We also request that your company preserve all evidence relating to the loss, including photographs, recorded statements, adjuster notes, vehicle inspection reports, telematics or dashcam data, and any repair estimates. Destruction or alteration of any such material could prejudice our client's claim, so please ensure that the appropriate litigation hold is placed on the file. We look forward to your prompt written acknowledgment of this request.
